nodes.label: Initialize App Once, Not Per Mount
nodes.source_location: ## Initialize App Once, Not Per Mount
nodes.rationale: useEffect([]) is not once-per-app: Strict Mode runs it twice in dev and remounts re-run it. A module-level didInit guard (or init in the entry module) is what actually gives once-per-app-load semantics for things like loadFromStorage and checkAuthToken.

edges.source_location: filename prefix says 'advanced' but frontmatter tags say initialization/useEffect/app-startup
the init-once example's loadFromStorage()/checkAuthToken() reads exactly the versioned client storage the localStorage rule governs
both escape per-component-instance semantics with module-level state (a didInit boolean vs a module-level Map of callbacks) because React effects are per-mount, not per-app
